_why: Hand-verified 2026-09-02. A Flask project that ships NO CSS and NO JavaScript of its own: Bootstrap arrives from cdn.jsdelivr.net as both a stylesheet and a bundle. Before the styles_are_local guard this repo produced 102 unresolved findings, every one of them a Bootstrap class that is styled perfectly well. The three below are what survived, and they are the same disease one level over - the CONSUMER is the CDN bundle rather than the stylesheet.

dom_attr:data:bs-toggle:app/templates/ba.why: data-bs-toggle is Bootstrap's own attribute, read by bootstrap.bundle.min.js which is loaded from jsdelivr and is not in the repo. Nothing local reads it and nothing local should.

dom_attr:data:bs-target:app/templates/ba.why: Same as bs-toggle: consumed by the CDN bundle, so 'unused' is a claim about a file the scan was never shown.

fetch_target:0.why: A bare '0' cannot be a route. Whatever produced it, it is not an endpoint this project fails to serve.
